patch_description:
The current program added unnecessary parameters (cry_bridge, rx_global, ry_global) that degraded performance. The first program achieved 0.91 with only 50 parameters through aggressive sharing.

This edit returns to the proven 50-parameter architecture (RY→RZ_pre→CZ chain→CRZ reverse chain→RZ_post structure) and duplicates the entire multi-stage block to form two back-to-back layers that reuse all parameter names. This tests whether increased depth (doubled to ~320) with full parameter sharing improves expressivity and convergence without increasing the parameter budget beyond 50.

Key differences from current:
- Removes cry_bridge, rx_global, ry_global (added bloat)
- Returns to CRZ alternation (crz_rev_a/b) instead of full sharing
- Duplicates entire block with parameter name reuse
- Maintains 50-parameter budget (2 layers × 25 unique params per layer with full sharing)
